Croatian citizenship application · Form helper (Obrazac 1)

How it works. Answer in English. The right-hand side shows the original form pages, with your answers written on top in Croatian. Yellow = still missing or still in English. Answers that depend on each other are handled for you: questions that don’t apply to you disappear, and answers that would contradict each other are filled in or locked automatically. Common job titles, fields of study, countries and relationships are translated for you (pick from the list). Anything else has a box for the Croatian wording — the Translate button opens Google Translate in a new tab.
Countries always print in Croatian (for example “USA” becomes “SAD”), also inside addresses.
Unofficial tool. Not affiliated with any Croatian authority. Check the current form, fees and document list with the Ministry of the Interior or your Croatian embassy/consulate. Your answers stay in this browser. Sign the printed form by hand — the place and date line (“U ____ dana ____”) is left blank so you complete it in person when you sign.
